annotations.title: Favicon finder: a site's icons and their sizes

description: Find a website's icons: every <link rel=icon>, shortcut icon, apple-touch-icon and mask-icon on the page with its size and type, the web app manifest link, and whether /favicon.ico exists, all as absolute URLs, with the best icon picked (SVG, then the largest size; mask icons never). Use to show a site's logo next to a link, build bookmarks or enrich a company record. Example: url=https://github.com/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
